question.text: A PM buys a bond with coupon 7% p.a. payable annually, face value Rs. 10,00,000, maturity 5 years, YTM 8%. What is the approximate price?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Price = 70,000 × PVIFA(8%,5) + 10,00,000 × PVIF(8%,5) = 70,000 × 3.9927 + 10,00,000 × 0.6806 = 2,79,489 + 6,80,583 = 9,60,072 ≈ Rs. 9,60,073. **The Trap:** Rs. 10,00,000 assumes par; Rs. 10,39,927 uses wrong discount direction; Rs. 9,28,053 uses 10% YTM. **Cross-Exam Context:** IV covers bond pricing; XXI-B builds on it. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** When YTM > coupon, bond trades below par. Memorise the five sign conventions — saves seconds on the exam.
